findings.title: Arena skill producer states are described as actual successful execution, and settlement lacks its surviving-battler gate
findings.ordinary_control: A living user executes an ordinary nonimmune, unprotected single-target move successfully: the completed processing state receives normal effectiveness and assigns skill +1. The state-to-skill table itself is correct when its actual state inputs are supplied.

minimal_counterexample.preconditions: Arena single battle; attack-phase skill slots are 0; opponent uses Protect before a living user attempts Tackle; normal execution and PP gates pass; Protect is effective, the move can be protected, Unseen Fist is absent; no secondary callbacks, recoil, replacement, or terminal outcome.
minimal_counterexample.trace: The target protection check marks protection and rejects that target. The hit processor returns false because no target is affected. The surrounding target-processing branch still records the completed-processing state (2), sums only unaffected=false targets and therefore obtains total effectiveness 0, then settles the living user. State 2 ignores the protection flag and assigns skill -2.
minimal_counterexample.reference_expected: Attacker current skill slot -2, accumulated at round end.
minimal_counterexample.formal_reader_expected: Reading “真正完成且成功” plus “被保护失败→不写” as a live behavioral rule gives unchanged slot 0. This conflates the labeled state with actual hit success.

findings.additional_precondition_gap: Settlement traverses existing, nonfainted battlers. A battler already at 0 HP is excluded even if its state is pending; the source does not settle every member of the entire battler array. Early execution/PP failure returns before the assumed-failure state is written. A later surviving battler action may settle an earlier pending whole-move failure; the last-action qualification in P26 is significant.
negative_search_scope: Full focal Arena 1–366 and selected UseMove 1–662 / success-check consumer ranges; no Arena-only guard around the ordinary settlement.
findings.cancellation_and_partial_failure: Preserve the existing last-action whole-move failure/no-EOR-backfill rule; distinguish pre-state failures, pending state settled by a later action, and actual target blockage. No rollback guarantee is introduced.
findings.minimal_fix: Describe state 1 as written only after execution/PP gates and usage bookkeeping reach its producer. Describe state 2 as completion of the target-processing branch, including zero affected targets, rather than requiring actual success. Qualify settlement to currently nonfainted battlers. Keep the direct state-to-skill table, explicitly restricting protected preservation to state 1; add a live Protect counterexample.
findings.proposed_clean_room_wording: 处理进入目标阶段并走到该阶段末尾时会写入完成状态，即使全部目标被保护或未命中；有目标时，相性只合计未被判无效的目标，全部排除则合计为0。完成状态按相性赋值技槽，合计0赋−2；保护标记只在仍处于失败状态时使技槽保持。结算只处理当前存在且尚未倒下的战斗者。前置资格或PP失败尚未到写入失败状态的时点。
dependencies_and_sync_files: WP40/WP43 execution and protection cross-reference; revise only if duplicated language is found
tests: Living Tackle against successful Protect: slot 0→-2; damage remains 0.
Direct state1/protected=true fixture preserves prior skill, without presenting it as ordinary Protect behavior.
Settlement excludes an already fainted battler; last-action early whole-move failure retains prior skill, whereas a later eligible settlement may consume its pending state.
findings.verification: Static semantic derivation; no reference execution or runtime test.

findings.title: WP58 field table shows constructor defaults where the actual facility consumer prepares values before capture
findings.ordinary_control: Constructor defaults are empty backdrop, nil base, time 0, and no environment before preparation. The recorder itself faithfully copies the values it receives at battle start.

minimal_counterexample.preconditions: Normal facility wrapper, debug skip absent, legal trainers and parties. No explicit backdrop, no next-battle backdrop, no surfing, and map metadata has no background; routine preparation returns normally.
minimal_counterexample.trace: The wrapper calls preparation before starting the recorded battle. Preparation always selects a backdrop and uses indoor1 when no other backdrop exists. The recorder then captures the prepared backdrop. A cave map likewise assigns time 2; environment is resolved or explicitly overridden and may supply a base.
minimal_counterexample.reference_expected: Even the fallback facility backdrop is indoor1, not the constructor empty string. Cave/map/override cases can record nondefault time, environment, and base.
minimal_counterexample.formal_reader_expected: The initial-condition field table currently labels backdrop/base as initially empty and time/environment as initially 0/none, without distinguishing constructor values from the prepared recording input.

negative_search_scope: Full RecordedBattle 47–67, facility wrapper 40–97, and preparation 209–304; these are the direct start consumers.
findings.cancellation_and_partial_failure: The claim is limited to normal preparation and capture. Debug skip creates no recording. Uncaught preparation errors need not reach capture; do not claim rollback or a default-filled record.
findings.minimal_fix: Replace the two field-table remarks with prepared current-value semantics; identify constructor defaults separately and cite the preparation dependency. Keep the existing 18-key count and restore behavior.
findings.proposed_clean_room_wording: 背景、背景基值、时段与环境在设施包装的开战准备后取现值记录：背景在没有其它来源时回落室内背景；环境、地图元数据、临时规则、冲浪状态与昼夜条件可改变所录值。空背景／空基值、0时段／无环境只是构造时默认值，不是正常设施录像的固定值。
tests: Fallback preparation then capture: backdrop indoor1.
Cave map preparation then capture: time 2 and resolved/overridden environment; base follows applicable environment/base configuration.
Playback restores the captured prepared values without invoking live preparation again.
findings.verification: Static semantic derivation; no reference execution or runtime test.

findings.title: Recorded Mega behavior lacks the Palace automatic-command precondition
findings.ordinary_control: Tower/Arena player reaches the regular fight menu and may toggle a qualified Mega registration; ordinary AI reaches its Mega registration step after deciding against switching/items. Recording adds no hook that cancels those paths, and omits the registration from the saved data.

minimal_counterexample.preconditions: Recorded Palace; living Mega-qualified battler, owner has the required ring, side unused, no external Mega registration, no Encore, at least one ordinarily selectable move. Player chooses Fight; equivalent AI case chooses no switch or item.
minimal_counterexample.trace: The player returns from the Palace automatic fight path before entering the regular menu containing the Mega toggle. The AI similarly returns from the Palace automatic path before its Mega registration step. Command-phase reset cleared pending registrations before selection.
minimal_counterexample.reference_expected: This ordinary Palace command path neither exposes the toggle nor registers Mega, despite eligibility.
minimal_counterexample.formal_reader_expected: The unqualified statement that the original recorded battle’s Mega toggle/registration/execution run normally and RC-W18’s eligibility-only prerequisite can be applied to Palace as well.

negative_search_scope: Full Palace automatic path and recorder do not add a separate Mega registration. No external/debug registration is asserted absent beyond the stated normal-path fixture.
findings.cancellation_and_partial_failure: A Tower/Arena canceled selection unregisters Mega through ordinary cancellation; Palace’s early automatic return is a separate route. Externally registered Mega and nonstandard overrides remain outside this minimal counterexample.
findings.minimal_fix: Qualify the original-recording Mega statement and RC-W18 to the ordinary menu/AI registration path (Tower/Arena), and add Palace’s bypass as a mode-specific limitation. Retain the record omission and replay inability for actually registered Mega.
findings.proposed_clean_room_wording: 记录机制本身不取消普通选招菜单或AI路径的Mega登记与执行；在实际到达这些路径并完成登记时，Mega可发生而登记不入录像。Palace常规自动选招在玩家手选菜单与AI的Mega登记步骤之前返回，不能仅凭Mega资格断言该模式会登记或执行。
tests: Qualified Tower/Arena, explicit player toggle: registration executes and is not recorded.
Same qualification in ordinary Palace Fight path: no toggle/registration, no Mega execution.
Palace AI choosing no switch/item returns before normal Mega registration.
findings.verification: Static semantic derivation; no reference execution or runtime test.

findings.title: Arena cancellation says all multiround moves, but the consumer preserves recharge
findings.ordinary_control: At the judgment threshold, two-turn charging and the listed ongoing repeat/locked move effects are canceled. The full-cancel option suppresses final-turn Outrage confusion.

minimal_counterexample.preconditions: Arena third round; both sides still have legal healthy reserves; living user successfully uses a recharge-producing attack on that round, survives and wins the coming judgment, with no external replacement or effect rewrite.
minimal_counterexample.trace: The successful move sets recharge to 2. Ordinary round-end countdown reduces it to 1. Arena invokes full move cancellation, which does not reset recharge and retains current-move identity while recharge is nonzero. The opponent is replaced; the winning user remains. Next round’s execution gate still requires recharge.
minimal_counterexample.reference_expected: Recharge 1 survives the judgment; the remaining user must recharge next round.
minimal_counterexample.formal_reader_expected: “取消双方所有多回合招” can be implemented as clearing recharge and allowing a new action next round.

negative_search_scope: Full cancellation consumer 75–95 and ordinary round-end tail 597–781; WP40 explicitly preserves recharge at lines186–188.
findings.cancellation_and_partial_failure: Limit the retained state to a judgment survivor. A loser faints and initialization clears its battle effects. Do not use a fixture where ordinary battle already ends before the Arena judgment.
findings.minimal_fix: Change all to the listed cancellable ongoing moves and explicitly preserve recharge; synchronize the compact difference row and P16 explanation, adding a surviving recharge example.
findings.proposed_clean_room_wording: 评判前取消双方的蓄力／连用／锁定等可取消持续招式（如两回合蓄力、滚动、逆鳞、吵闹与忍耐），全取消不触发逆鳞末轮混乱；不清除破坏死光类回复计数。评判后仍在场的胜者可在下一轮继续受回复期限制。
tests: Third-round surviving recharge user: 2→1 at ordinary round end, remains1 after judgment, recharge gate next round.
Judgment loser replacement clears its own battle effects normally.
findings.verification: Static semantic derivation; no reference execution or runtime test.

findings.title: Palace best switch candidate needs positive integer HP percentage; zero-percent live candidates use the fallback branch
findings.ordinary_control: A legal reserve with integer HP percentage at least1 becomes the best candidate when it exceeds the current maximum; probability hit registers that candidate and returns before updating the just-switched marker.

minimal_counterexample.preconditions: Palace AI living user h24, no status bonus, old just-switched=false; no Perish Song1 and no no-move/turn>5 branch; exactly one legal nonactive reserve with HP1/total205, no trapping, normal registration succeeds; random0. One realizable shape is a Pikachu user at24/100 and a distinct Lapras reserve at1/205.
minimal_counterexample.trace: Reserve integer percentage is0. The best-candidate selection starts at maximum0 and accepts only a strict increase, so no best index is assigned. Factor30 and random0 produce should-switch=true; the later branch writes just-switched=true and registers the first legal reserve.
minimal_counterexample.formal_reader_expected: Taking “取其最高占比m” and “存在最佳候选（m对应成员）” as selecting the mathematical maximum gives that live reserve as best, enters early return, and keeps marker false.

negative_search_scope: Full Palace195–243; only the strict-positive selection path can create the best index; fallback independently checks switch legality.
No inference that zero percentage means fainted: replacement qualification tests actual fainted status/HP.
findings.cancellation_and_partial_failure: Retain distinction between probability hit, marker update, registration, and successful return. With no legal candidate the later marker may still become true but returnfalse (existing P12).
findings.minimal_fix: State that best-candidate tracking chooses the first strict maximum above initial0; a legal live reserve can round to0 and leave no best candidate, then probability hits use the first-legal fallback and update the marker. Add an adjacent1-percent control.
findings.proposed_clean_room_wording: 最佳候选只在其整数HP百分比严格高于从0开始的当前最大值时登记；并列保持先遇者。合法存活后备的百分比可整除为0，此时仍没有最佳候选：概率命中后进入后段、写「刚换过」为真，再登记首个合法后备。
tests: h24, sole reserve1/205, r0, prior markerfalse: factor30, switch true, markertrue.
Same inputs except reserve3/205: factor30, switch true, markerfalse via early return.
No legal reserve, r0: markertrue but switchfalse; keep P12.
findings.verification: Static semantic derivation; no reference execution or runtime test.
